| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `string` | yes | — | Queued task ID to override |
| `profile_id` | `string` | yes | — | Worker profile that must run the task |
| `reason` | `string` | yes | — | Why the router's choice is overridden (10-400 characters); recorded on the route, the event and a task comment |
| `intelligence_class` | `string` | no | — | Class to run at. Default: the profile's fixed class, else the task's class hint. Must be one the profile can run. |
